title: You Have Got Pizza: Deluxe Edition
subtitle: C'e pizza per te

authors.role: concept, the original demonstrator, project lead
authors.name: Raffaele Montella - UniParthenope

acknowledgements: To every teacher whose cool tools make students hungry for knowledge, and foolish enough to try hard things.

Mechanics inspired by the earlier You Have Got Pizza demonstrator of the PRG32 family and by the walk-over-the-ingredients arcade genre. All characters, levels, pictures, music, sounds and code are original to this game.
Every picture is generated from text sources in tools/; every sound is the PRG32 SID-like synthesizer playing an original score. No samples, no recordings, no third-party assets.
PRG32 framework: tiles, indexed sprites, palette and the eight-voice stereo mixer.
content_notice: No violence: students are fed, never hurt. They are only dazed by a cloud of flour.
